xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex083012026-09-1804-30-19" status="unreviewed">  'di dag la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4291">brang ti</rs> na re 'dir bshad pa ni bye brag tu smra ba dang | rnam par gtan la dbab  par bsdu bar bshad ba ni mdo sde pa dang | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">kun las btus</rs> las bshad pa ni sems tsam pa'i lugs yin no zhes zer <note type="gloss">la zla cog gi Ti kar yang | mthong bas spang bya'i phra rgyas las | <quote>grub mtha' smra ba gsum gyis ni | brgyad bcu brgyad dang dgu bcu bzhi | brgya rtsa bcu gnyis dag tu 'dod ces</quote> 'byung |</note> mod kyi | 'on kyang lugs phyi ma gnyis ni rnam pa 'gal tsam dang dngos su 'gal ba'i dbang du byas nas bshad pa yin no zhes mchims gsung ngo |</seg></TEI>
